name: The Rider
kern: The Rider sets things in motion: something is coming your way, usually faster than you think – a message, a visit or a new impulse.
rat: Stay flexible and open yourself to what is arriving.

name: The Clover
kern: The Clover brings a happy moment: small, light and fleeting. Whoever notices it can use it.
rat: Reach for what is light and enjoy it.

name: The Ship
kern: The Ship leaves the harbour: it stands for departure, wide horizons and everything that leads beyond everyday life.
rat: Set sail when you know where you want to go.

name: The House
kern: The House shows what carries you: your home, your family and everything you have built.
rat: Look after what carries you and build on it.

name: The Tree
kern: The Tree grows slowly and deeply: it stands for health, constancy and developments that last.
rat: Give what you are building the time it needs.

name: The Clouds
kern: The Clouds cover the view: something is unclear, and a decision needs more clarity.
rat: Wait until the sky clears, and ask questions.

name: The Snake
kern: The Snake winds: it shows detours and entanglements but also cleverness and adaptability.
rat: Take the detour with open eyes and stay honest.

name: The Coffin
kern: The Coffin almost never stands for death but for an ending: something is over, rests or may be let go.
rat: Let go of what is over and make room.

name: The Bouquet
kern: The Bouquet is a friendly gesture: a gift, an invitation, a compliment.
rat: Give a friendly word and accept one.

name: The Scythe
kern: The Scythe cuts clearly and fast: it separates what is ripe and brings either a break or a harvest.
rat: Decide clearly and harvest what is ripe.

name: The Whip
kern: The Whip stands for confrontation: it shows quarrels, reproaches and patterns that want to be settled.
rat: Say it out loud before it repeats itself.

name: The Birds
kern: The Birds twitter all at once: conversations, calls, exchange and sometimes nervousness.
rat: Speak with care and listen closely.

name: The Child
kern: The Child stands for everything small and new: a beginning, openness and trust.
rat: Begin without reserve and give the new time to grow.

name: The Fox
kern: The Fox is clever and watchful: it advises caution and at the same time stands for daily work.
rat: Trust your instinct, but check before you commit.

name: The Bear
kern: The Bear is powerful and protective: it stands for strength, influence and abundance but can also seem dominant.
rat: Use your strength to protect, not to rule.

name: The Stars
kern: The Stars show the way: they stand for hope, inspiration and the feeling of being on the right course.
rat: Hold on to your goal and take the first step.

name: The Stork
kern: The Stork brings change: it stands for change for the better, moving house, changes of place and sometimes a baby.
rat: Allow the new and welcome the change.

name: The Dog
kern: The Dog is faithful and loyal: it shows a reliable friend and the strength that comes from connection.
rat: Look after the people who stand by you, and stand by them.

name: The Tower
kern: The Tower stands for distance and overview: for authorities, institutions and the wish to withdraw.
rat: Gain distance for the overview, but leave the door open.

name: The Garden
kern: The Garden is a place of encounter: for parties, society and showing yourself.
rat: Show yourself and keep up your contacts.

name: The Mountain
kern: The Mountain stands in the way: it shows an obstacle or delay that demands patience and endurance.
rat: Go step by step and do not give up.

name: The Paths
kw: Decision · Choice · Fork in the Road
kern: The Paths divide: you must choose, and the card asks for a conscious decision.
rat: Decide consciously and walk your path.

name: The Mice
kern: The Mice gnaw quietly but steadily: they stand for loss, worries and everything that slowly wears you down.
rat: Protect your strength and seal what gnaws at it.

name: The Heart
kern: The Heart stands for love in all its forms: affection, compassion and what you truly care about.
rat: Follow your heart and think along with it.

name: The Ring
kern: The Ring closes into a circle: it stands for bonds, promises, contracts and everything that returns.
rat: Commit consciously and keep what you promise.

name: The Book
kern: The Book is closed or open: it stands for knowledge, learning and a secret that is revealed or kept.
rat: Keep learning and ask questions.

name: The Letter
kern: The Letter is a written message: it stands for letters, emails, documents and everything that is put on record.
rat: Put important things in writing and read closely.

name: The Man
kern: The Man is a person card: he stands for the questioner if this image represents you better, or for an important man in your surroundings.
rat: Look closely at the role this person plays.

name: The Woman
kern: The Woman is a person card: she stands for the questioner if this image represents you better, or for an important woman in your surroundings.
rat: Look closely at the role this person plays.

name: The Lily
kern: The Lily is quiet and pure: it brings calm, maturity and harmony.
rat: Grow quiet and notice what is ripe.

name: The Sun
kern: The Sun is the brightest card in the deck: where it falls, things become clear, warm and alive.
rat: Show yourself and accept the good that is yours.

name: The Moon
kern: The Moon shows feelings, intuition and creativity: it stands for earned recognition and for moods that come and go.
rat: Listen to your inner voice and show what you can do.

name: The Key
kern: The Key opens what was locked: it stands for solution, breakthrough and certainty.
rat: Open the door that shows itself.

name: The Fish
kern: The Fish swim in the stream: they stand for money, abundance and business, for everything that flows, comes and goes.
rat: Use the flow and put something aside.

name: The Anchor
kern: The Anchor gives support: it stands for constancy, a goal reached and everything that holds you securely, in good ways and in stuck ones.
rat: Find your support and check whether it carries you.

name: The Cross
kern: The Cross stands for fate, burden and trial but also for meaning and significance.
rat: Carry what is yours and share what is too heavy.
